scheme.title: MOSAIC themes
scheme.description: Closed list used to browse and filter the catalogue. A record has one or more; the first is its primary theme. v0.1: the 13 MFL categories plus climate, adaptation and mitigation (guided by the Climate Data Hub domains).

concepts.label: Boundaries / admin units
concepts.description: Administrative units, landscape and watershed boundaries used to delineate or aggregate data.

concepts.label: Land cover / land use
concepts.description: What covers the land and how it is used, including change between dates.

concepts.label: Ecosystem condition
concepts.description: State of ecosystems: vegetation, soil and water condition indicators.

concepts.label: Degradation / land health
concepts.description: Soil properties, erosion and land degradation.

concepts.label: Water / hydrology
concepts.description: Water bodies, river networks, rainfall and other hydro-climatic observations.

concepts.label: Biodiversity / ecosystems
concepts.description: Species, habitats, protected and conservation areas.

concepts.label: Pressures / drivers
concepts.description: Pressures on the landscape: deforestation, fire, human footprint, vulnerability.

concepts.label: Ecosystem services
concepts.description: Benefits people obtain from ecosystems and their assessment.

concepts.label: Hotspots / leverage points
concepts.description: Places or factors where intervention has the largest effect.

concepts.label: Scenarios / future risks
concepts.description: Projections, scenarios and future risk assessments.

concepts.label: Decision-support outputs
concepts.description: Products made to inform decisions: plans, prioritisation maps, dashboards.

concepts.label: Agrobiodiversity / crops
concepts.description: Crops, crop fields, varieties, production and yield.

concepts.label: Socio-economic / livelihoods
concepts.description: Population, livelihoods, markets, institutions and other socio-economic data.

concepts.label: Climate
concepts.description: Observed, reanalysis, projected and scenario climate data: temperature, precipitation and other variables.

concepts.label: Climate adaptation
concepts.description: Vulnerability, exposure, climate risk assessment and adaptation planning.

concepts.label: Climate mitigation
concepts.description: Emissions, carbon stocks, sequestration and mitigation pathways.
